== Trivia ==
* Below '''Hypixel Discord'''{{'}}s nametag is text that says {{Rmt|&e&lCLICK TO JOIN!}}.
* The player receives an {{Rmt|&5⌬}} [[Emblem]] as a reward for connecting a [[w:Discord|Discord]] account to the [[Hypixel Network]].
** This is most likely a reference to the Server Boost [[w:Discord|Discord]] icon.
* Their mask references the [[w:Discord|Discord]] logo. The character on the hoodie is Wumpus, [[w:Discord|Discord]]'s mascot.
* This [[NPC]] was positioned where {{NPCSprite|Security Sloth}} used to be, who was moved into the {{Zone|Security Hall}} a few days later.
